sections.normalized_html:
The scatterplot shows the data on how many hours children of different ages slept in a day, collected by a doctor in a survey that involved [MATH: 5] participants. A line of best fit is also shown. How long (in hours) does a [MATH: 7]-year-old child sleep in a day, as predicted by the line of best fit?

  1. [MATH: 8.14] hours

  2. [MATH: 13.54] hours

  3. [MATH: 3.77] hours

  4. [MATH: 10.85] hours
